summary: Accepted after an independent complete Chinese-source and sealed-candidate review. The governing memorial is explicitly Guangxu 21, twelfth month (AD 1895), while its later phrase 上年六月至十二月 means the preceding Guangxu year, AD 1894. The candidate changes exactly Hart claims 61 and 81 from AD 1895 to AD 1894, preserves their Chinese wording, owner, predicate, action, certainty, and evidence, and changes no canonical data.

sourceEvidence.quote: 二十一年十二月，署南洋大臣張之洞疏請舉辦郵政。
上年六月至十二月，復與總稅務司面商屢次，先後據其遞到四項章程，計四十四款。
應請旨敕下臣衙門，轉飭總稅務司赫德專司其事，仍由臣衙門總其成，即照赫德所擬章程，定期開辦。
